text_block_list.text: As the days passed heading toward the Kyoto Kinen, the promise made at the New Year was fulfilled, and as for us—

To hone the weapon known as her late-stretch burst, discovered on her trip to Hong Kong...
she undertook special training with Duramente.
However...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Gaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I'll go get some water.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Don't slack off either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you.
I'll do just that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(She's still got plenty in the tank, huh... But it makes total sense.
I haven't been able to push her
into a corner at all...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, this is way beyond polishing my late spurt...
I'm completely overwhelmed.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (From the intense pressure she gives off. From her approaching aura. From a power... that inspires sheer awe.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(So this is her stride...
Running to be "the strongest"—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Still, ngh...! I have to surpass it.
I have to be able to overcome it!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (To latch onto the back of an evolving Kitasan and overtake her! To win!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Somehow, some way!
I have to gain power like hers—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Like... her?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I was just lost in thought.
Don't worry, I'm fine."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's about time to clock out, right?
So, like—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Tomorrow is the last time
we get to run with Duramente-san, right?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Right, of course.
............
choice_data_list: ...Want to have a meeting after this?
...Want to have a meeting after this?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—No.
I'm fine. I'll get on stage as scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
...Please let me think about it alone for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (......"Strength like hers," I thought.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Only after wishing did I realize. She... Duramente-san...)
"Who is the Umamusume you look up to?"
"‘Who is the Umamusume you look up to?’"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Well, there isn't one.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(To someone like me back then,
maybe this was the first time...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Lights out soon... Days really do go by fast, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, huh?
In front of the room, Duramente and—)

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: W-Well then...! Sorry for disturbing you so late at night!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering for you...!
G-Good night!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how cute! Fufufu, did you see that?
Those kids were wagging their tails so excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Besides, it smells kind of nice.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Protein cookies, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I see. She must have put a lot of thought into it, knowing she was giving it to someone as stoic as you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...The object of everyone's 'admiration.'
As expected of you, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So surely, I too—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You're different, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah... Wait a second, Duramente-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Geez. You're not getting away—we're roommates, after all.
...What did you mean by that earlier?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of dodging the question.
I meant exactly what I said.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You don't admire me at all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...You don't admire anyone, not even in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"No... No no no.
Where'd you get that kind of confidence?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, you know?
Normally, isn't that a common occurrence for us Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Having someone you look up to, an objective, or someone you feel a destined connection with... that's why you can keep trying your best, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Even for you, Air Groove is someone who—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah, they're here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However, you don't have one.
Without a doubt, you don't.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, that's why!
Jeez, what do you take me for?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You are... who you are. Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am nothing other than that,
and I can never become anything else.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: If you run alongside them, you'll understand.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"‘Admiration’? No. You will strive toward no one.
You will take guidance from no one."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Your compass
always lies within yourself."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That is why I shall not yearn, shall not waver,
and shall not yield.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No matter how mighty the opponent may be.
No matter what adversity one is driven into.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Guided by a single unbreakable compass needle held close to her heart,
she overcomes everything, stepping past every trial,
and keeps clawing her way toward the crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Because you yourself have defined
that this is who you are—
that this is "Satono Crown."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow is the last day of our joint intensive training, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Our final tandem run.
Just as before, I won't allow you
to cross the line ahead of me even once."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Good night, Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (The one who wished for "power like hers" was...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(It's true... because I wanted to surpass them.
Because I wanted to win. Just that, and nothing more.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, yes.
If I can only ever be myself.
If that's all that's left for me.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (In that case—!!)

"And then came the final day of intensive training.
As for Satono Crown—"

In complete contrast to every day before this.
She radiated a terribly sharp aura.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —It is all ready.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin, then.
...This is our final joint training.

The two stand on the track, taking their starting stances.
Swallowing hard in the overwhelming tension,
I give the call.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Acknowledge it.
...Be certain of it. And then, carry it through to the end.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(I idolize no one.
I yield to no one.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Holding fast to the ambition I set for myself,
I simply push forward.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Overturn the odds, surpass them all, and claim the crown!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Just—push forward!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Push through. Stay devoted. Be stubborn!
In a way that only I can, my own way!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Use your head! Discern it! The absolute best moment to make a move! The chance at victory to overturn everything!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Because the pinnacle! This crown is!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (I won't give it up to anyone, not to a single soul—!!)

text_block_list.name: Crown & Dura
text_block_list.text:
—Haa!!
Haa, haa, haa...!!

Just the slightest difference.
And yet, undeniably. ...Undeniably.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ――You finished first.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It was a razor-sharp late surge. ...Like nothing I had ever seen before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well, you've gone out of your way to help an enemy,
fully intending that defeating them afterward
is your true mission, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"You understand completely, don't you?
――Both of us do."
After exchanging one final look with Duramente, Satono Crown walked over to me with calm, composed strides.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It's done, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...With this, our preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"With these legs sharper than anyone else's.
And holding in my heart the will to seize the crown, never letting victory slip away."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's go. First up is the Kyoto Kinen!
To throw everything we've gained at it!
